class: a tier no worktree can host, with no base result, so every red already on the base blocked QA as the change's
caught_by: Step 0d runs every declared scope: whole tier through the barrier with --whole at the run's base, in place and on every run, whatever baseline_sweep says, and never a change-selected tier. Its whole record at the base's key serves QA's base side, and a tier that a Commands suite maps to gets a baseline ledger row with file-qualified failing names. Run in the background, as one chain from the repository root, it records the dispatch, re-records it before a turn waits for it, and is joined before the first coder dispatch on a file of exit codes the chain writes only after its last tier
missed_by: a baseline sweep that skipped the tiers needing running services, or was written by hand outside the engine, so a red already on the base had no row and no base, blocked QA, and sent a test-only loop to remediation
